issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases, such as handling network failures or missing objects.
The skill is vendor-locked to Spline and does not work with other 3D design tools or generic AI agents.

scenarios.name: react-hero-cube-move
scenarios.rationale: Response A partially meets the rubric but misses the required onLoad cube positioning and sets the position incorrectly; Response B does not use Spline at all and thus fails the rubric.

scenarios.name: viewer-lazy-load-hide-placeholder
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes all required elements and correctly implements the load-complete handler, while Response B lacks the viewer script, spline-viewer element, and uses the wrong event name.

scenarios.name: vanilla-mouseclick-set-variable
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers almost all rubric items except the canvas id, while Response B fails to import Application, uses a different library, and wrong event type.
